name: vpk-html
description: Builds offline, single-file HTML, led by two-column paper-system story explainers where the text scrolls on the left while an animated figure on the right scrubs with it, readable as Page, Slides, X Threads or Video. Also renders reports, one-pagers, briefs, memos, decks, changelogs, portfolios, resumes and engineering pages from supplied material.
